analysis.reasonEn: 3 consecutive sessions of wait-and-see. RSI edged up from 37.2 to 38.7 but remains in neutral territory. MACD histogram improved from -27.9425 to -9.6694 but stays negative. Lack of multi-timeframe alignment.

· 스윙 저항선 ($2,423.04): SMA5($2,423.48)와 일치, 단기 저항 구간

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($2,386.33) vs SMA5/20/50 ($2,423.48/$2,506.43/$2,550.9): below short/mid-term trends, indicating mid-to-long-term trend position.
· Position relative to SMA100/200 ($2,302.2/$2,154.66): above long-term trends, maintaining an uptrend.
· 52-week position (32.1%) + current price range approaching historical low levels.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (37.2→38.7): attempting to exit oversold but staying in neutral zone, weak directional momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-27.9425→-9.6694): improving but still in negative territory, indicating bearish convergence.
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $2,506.43): consolidating near the mid-band, with a band width of 17.50% suggesting moderate volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($2,378.39): based on Pivot S1 ($2,225.17) and SMA100 ($2,302.2).
· Swing resistance ($2,423.04): aligning with SMA5 ($2,423.48), acting as short-term resistance.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Sideways): no Higher Low or Lower High formed, indicating absence of trend reversal signals.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.37x): increased volume adds conviction to price movement, boosting directional reliability.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): digesting supply near support, requiring confirmation of resistance breakout for further upside.
